answer.reason: The verses show events that happened at Kiriath-jearim: the ark was kept there, and David later brought it up from there.

clauses.english: received the ark of the LORD, which stayed there twenty years
clauses.quote: the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD

clauses.english: was where David went with all Israel to bring up the ark of God
clauses.quote: the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim

doubts: JDG 18:12 (the Danites camping behind the city) was left out as a minor stage of a journey.
JOS 9:17 (one of the Gibeonite cities) was left out because it only names the city.
JER 26:20 concerns Urijah, the prophet from the city, so it was left out.
